{{Quote|Sir! You're heading into enemy territory. It's thick with droids and bugs.|The clone trooper, to Boss|<ref name="SWRC" />}}
A '''clone trooper''' served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], they participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], the war's opening engagement, supporting several other [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], including [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]], in successfully defending a barricade from advancing Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. The clone survived the attack and took part in pushing the droids back to a Separatist gun emplacement.

==Biography==
[[Cloning/Legends|Born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="Enc" /> the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] clone of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].<ref name="DB" /> The clone served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="SWRC" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], the first conflict of the Clone Wars, as the Republic fought to capture the Separatist-held planet.<ref name="SWRC" />

Alongside fellow [[Soldier/Legends|troopers]]&mdash;[[17]], [[Three-Five]], and a third trooper&mdash;the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] were defending a barricade from Separatist [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] when [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]] approached the group. The trooper warned the [[Commando/Legends|commando]] of the dangers ahead, specifically the large number of enemy combatants. As Boss entered the area, the attacking [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] blew through a wall, [[Death/Legends|killing]] one of the troopers. The surviving clones defended themselves against the assault and prevented the droids' advance, proceeding to push the droid line back to a Separatist gun emplacement.<ref name="SWRC" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of Jango Fett,<ref name="DB" /> the clone trooper stood at a height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]<ref name="Enc" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> The trooper warned Boss of the large number of hostile combatants ahead of the commando, showing loyalty and camaraderie with fellow clones.<ref name="SWRC" />

==Equipment==
The clone trooper wore white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]]<ref name="SWRC" /><ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> and was armed with a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]].<ref name="SWRC" /><ref name="ROTSVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This clone trooper appeared in the [[2005]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''.<ref name="SWRC" />
